servinfo.title: Maintenance Recommended under Severe Driving Conditions (Except for Europe)
servinfo.ptxt: Follow this schedule if your vehicle is mainly operated under one or more of the following conditions.

item.ptxt: When most trips are less than 6 km (4 miles).
When most trips are less than 16 km (10 miles) and outside air temperature remains below freezing.
Idling and/or low-speed operation in stop-and-go traffic.
Operating in extremely cold weather and/or on salted roads.
Operating in rough and/or muddy areas.
Operating in dusty areas.
Repeated high speed drive or high engine revolutions.
Towing a trailer, if admitted.

servinfo.ptxt: Schedule should also be followed if the vehicle is used for delivery service, police, taxi or other commercial applications.

item.ptxt: The intervals should be determined based on odometer readings or months, whichever comes first.
The following table shows the service schedule up to 60,000 km (36,000 miles). Beyond 60,000 km (36,000 miles), perform the same maintenance services at the same intervals shown in the table.
This table shows the typical maintenance schedule.
The actual maintenance schedule, however, varies depending on vehicle specifications, so the typical maintenance schedule may not be applicable to some models.

Therefore, for the maintenance schedule that is specifically applicable to the vehicle being serviced, follow the relevant instructions in the “Maintenance Recommended under Severe Driving Conditions” under “INSPECTION AND MAINTENANCE” section of the Owner’s Manual.
